name: Corpre
text:
Corpre is a variant spelling of Cairbre, a common male name of early Ireland.
MacKillop lists Corpre among the many written forms of that name.
The name belonged to kings, warriors, and poets across legend and history.
Readers should follow the Cairbre entry for the full story.
